masteryZone.q: Which ecological landscape (Tinai) is associated with the coastal strip and the deity Varunan?
masteryZone.sol: Neithal is the coastal landscape where Varunan was worshipped.

masteryZone.q: The barter system was absent in Sangam society, and all transactions were completed using gold coins.
masteryZone.sol: Barter system was highly active. Salt and fish were routinely exchanged for rice and honey.

masteryZone.q: The patron deity of the Kurinji (mountainous) region was ______.
masteryZone.sol: Murugan or Seyon was the deity of Kurinji.

masteryZone.q: Which social class in Tolkappiyam represented the merchants and traders?
masteryZone.sol: Vanigar represented the merchants and traders.

masteryZone.q: The Anthanars were the ruling monarchs who commanded standing armies.
masteryZone.sol: Arasar was the ruling class; Anthanars were priests and ritual specialists.

masteryZone.q: Match the class with their typical occupation:
masteryZone.sol: Arasar - Rulers, Anthanar - Priests, Vanigar - Traders, Vellalar - Farmers.

masteryZone.q: What did the term 'Kaimai Nonbu' signify in early Tamil country?
masteryZone.sol: Kaimai Nonbu refers to the rigid, ascetic lifestyle led by widows.

masteryZone.q: Female poets had no intellectual recognition and were forbidden from writing literature in the Sangam age.
masteryZone.sol: Over 30 female poets (e.g. Avvaiyar) wrote premium Sangam poems.

masteryZone.q: What was the term used to describe self-immolation or Sati by a widow on her husband's pyre?
masteryZone.sol: Teeppaydal was the self-immolation of widows.

masteryZone.q: Which of the following was a local deity representing the goddess of victory and war?
masteryZone.sol: Korravai was the goddess of war and victory, associated with Palai.

masteryZone.q: Hero stones (Nadukal) were worshipped as guardian spirits of the village.
masteryZone.sol: Yes, Nadukal were erected in honor of fallen warriors and were offered regular worship.

masteryZone.q: The travelling bards or singers who sang in royal courts were known as ______.
